Strategy: Combine the item-scaled wide band with an item-scaled sliver penalty, rewarding half an item for leftovers between twenty-five and fifty and penalizing half an item below ten. It may help by attracting good leftovers and repelling dead ones at item scale, but may fail if the two effects conflict.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (item / 2 if r - item < 10 else 0) for r in bins]
```
